description: The plot illustrates the relationship between input text and Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) scores for different trigger word insertion methods. The x-axis represents input text, with labels “bb”, “mb”, “cf”, “beautiful”, “excellent”, “gorgeous”, “wonderfully”, “brilliant”, and “stunningly”. The scale is categorical. The y-axis represents ASR scores, with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, in increments of 0.2, and labeled with units “ASR”. A green line with triangle markers begins at approximately 0.75 at “bb”, decreases to approximately 0.2 at “mb”, increases to approximately 0.8 at “cf”, then fluctuates between approximately 0.7 and 0.9 through “stunningly”, ending at approximately 0.85. An orange line with ‘x’ markers begins at approximately 0.1 at “bb”, increases to approximately 0.6 at “cf”, then fluctuates between approximately 0.5 and 0.7 through “stunningly”, ending at approximately 0.6. A purple line with circle markers begins at approximately 0.45 at “bb”, decreases to approximately 0.6 at “mb”, decreases to approximately 0.5 at “cf”, increases to approximately 0.8 at “beautiful”, decreases to approximately 0.6 at “excellent”, increases to approximately 0.9 at “gorgeous”, decreases to approximately 0.7 at “wonderfully”, increases to approximately 0.8 at “brilliant”, and ends at approximately 0.75 at “stunningly”.
